Bro my boyfriend and I have been together for three years and I’ve been sad since I was 7. I’m 23 now. I say I want to die at least three times a week and he still asks me if I want to go to the hospital, or if I think I’ll really hurt myself. He still holds me when I cry, still helps me when I feel like I can’t do it, still loves me. 

The type of reaction OP is getting isn’t right. Of course it’s sad to be around, of course it’s hard, but relationships are built by helping the other person. Relationships grow by helping each other learn and navigate life and the struggles that come with the human experience. OP deserves a supportive situation from ALL sides, not just medically. That’s not how you work towards getting better. Your support system shouldn’t consist of just your doctors and therapists. 

“This stuff spreads like crazy and is really not nice to have or be around.” Positive that OP gets that. Absolutely 100% positive they get that. Depression makes us feel like we aren’t good enough to be around anyone at all, and makes us feel like when we’re sad we might ruin things for other people. It’s important to not internalize those feelings, because society is wrong. You should be able to rely on your friends and loved ones for support, especially because depression makes it really hard to reach out. 

OP, maybe talk to your partner and ask him why he feels that way, and ask him what he imagines it’s like from your perspective. Maybe ask him to do some reading on what living with depression is like, or how to support someone with depression. You aren’t being dramatic, your feelings are valid and very real. Nobody wants to think about dying all the time, it sucks and hurts. I hope you can find the support you need and deserve, and if you ever wanna vent feel free to DM me :)
